input.summary: Collect the numbered lanes for the full game. Then hit the moving 10x target when its matching number is also lit for 5,000.

steps.text: Plunge for 4 first. Then collect 7 and 5. Do not plunge through 6.
modeNotes: Numbered lane: A collected number stays lit for the full game and raises its matching drop target from 50 to 500.
Some 3-ball settings award 4 and 7 as a pair, and 1 and 3 as a pair. Read the lamps after each collect.

steps.text: Shoot up through lane 6 from the left flipper. Use the return to collect another missing number.
When the ball is on the right flipper, hit the drop target that has both its number lamp and the moving 10x lamp on.
modeNotes: Double-lit target: The number lamp raises the target to 500. The moving 10x lamp raises that hit to 5,000.
A 10x target without its number scores 500. A numbered target without 10x also scores 500.

steps.text: Use a center-bumper hit to move the 10x lamp when the current double-lit target is down or unsafe.
If one target remains in the bank, finish it for 5,000. The bank resets, so the moving 10x target becomes available again.
modeNotes: Target-bank completion: Scores 5,000 and raises all seven drops for another scoring cycle.

steps.text: Repeat the available 5,000 target. Continue to collect missing numbers whenever no good target is available.

fallback.title: Numbers first
fallback.when: Use this when the moving 10x target is down, its rebound is unsafe, or too few numbers are lit.

steps.text: Send the ball up top from either flipper.
Collect a new number. The number stays lit for the rest of the game.
Return to the drops after several matching targets are worth 500.

alternatives.title: Finish the bank
alternatives.when: Use this when the lit 5,000 target is down and only one or two safer targets remain.

steps.text: Clear the remaining targets.
Collect the 5,000 bank-completion award.
Shoot the newly raised double-lit target for another 5,000.

buildsToward.title: Seven lit numbers and repeatable 5,000 targets

steps.text: Collect all seven numbers. Progress is held for the full game.
Follow the moving 10x lamp and hit each available matching target.
Reset the bank and repeat the 5,000 hits.

techniques.name: Lane 6 up-shot
techniques.instruction: From the left flipper, shoot the ball up through lane 6. Do not collect 6 with a plunge from above.

techniques.name: Dead bounce
techniques.instruction: Let a consistent right-side feed bounce from the left flipper to the right. Use a drop catch or raised-flipper cradle if the dead bounce is short.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: As the ball descends the right lane, time a left-flipper backhand to targets 1 through 4. Use it only when the normal catch does not reach safety.

cautions.issue: A ball falling through top lane 6 can drain straight down the middle.
cautions.response: Avoid the 6 plunge. Nudge an accidental top feed away from 6, and collect 6 with the left-flipper up-shot.

cautions.issue: The fast lane 1 exit and slower lane 2 or 3 exit need different control.
cautions.response: Watch each first return. Nudge at the lower rubber only when that specific speed needs it.

cautions.issue: Drop-target rebounds vary by target and by shooting flipper.
cautions.response: Change flippers or shoot on the move when a cradle shot rebounds toward a drain.

cautions.issue: A ball that reaches either outlane is usually lost.
cautions.response: Nudge before the ball enters the outlane. Do not expect a late recovery after it crosses the posts.
